Correlation matrix of protein expression

Source: R/plot_corr.R
plot_corr.Rd

Computes pairwise correlations between proteins (or samples) and renders a correlation matrix plot. Uses `corrplot::corrplot()` for visualization.

Usage

plot_corr(
  data,
  method = "spearman",
  assay_col = NULL,
  value_col = NULL,
  sample_col = NULL,
  wide = NULL,
  top_n = 30,
  corr_type = "upper",
  display_method = "color",
  order = "hclust",
  tl.cex = NULL,
  show_coef = FALSE,
  coef_cex = NULL,
  col = NULL,
  cl_pos = "r",
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame in long format (or wide if `wide = TRUE`), or an OlinkExperiment.

method

Correlation method: "pearson", "spearman" (default), or "kendall".

assay_col

Name of the assay column (long format). If NULL, auto-detected (e.g. "Assay").

value_col

Name of the NPX value column (long format). If NULL, auto-detected (e.g. "NPX").

sample_col

Name of the sample ID column (long format). If NULL, auto-detected (e.g. "SampleID").

wide

If TRUE, data is in wide format with samples as rows. If NULL (default), format is detected automatically.

top_n

Limit to the top N assays by variance (default 30).

corr_type

Type of corrplot: "full", "upper", or "lower" (default "upper").

display_method

Visual method for corrplot: "color" (default), "circle", "ellipse", "number", "shade", or "pie".

order

Ordering method: "hclust" (default), "AOE", "FPC", "alphabet", or "original".

tl.cex

Text label size. If NULL (default), 0.7; in journal-size mode (`options(olinkviz.base_size)` below 11) the tick-label size, `(base_size - 1) / 12`.

show_coef

Logical; if TRUE, print the numeric correlation coefficient inside each cell (corrplot `addCoef.col`). Default FALSE. Use with `display_method = "circle"` for a triangular coefficient matrix.

coef_cex

Size of the coefficient labels. If NULL (default), 0.7; in journal-size mode (`options(olinkviz.base_size)` below 11) the tick-label size, `(base_size - 1) / 12`.

col

Optional color palette (character vector) passed to corrplot. Defaults to a blue-white-red diverging palette.

cl_pos

Position of the color legend: "r" (right), "l" (left), "b" (bottom), "t" (top), or "n" (none). Default "r".

...

Additional arguments passed to `corrplot::corrplot()`.

Value

Invisibly returns the correlation matrix.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Column names and long/wide format are detected automatically
plot_corr(beatmg_npx, top_n = 20)
plot_corr(pcnsl_olink, top_n = 20)
} # }
